brief:
Israeli settlers demolished a memorial to Al Jazeera journalist Shireen Abu Akleh near Jenin, according to the Palestinian news agency Wafa. The settlers arrived in two vehicles at the Ajja roundabout, south of the city, and destroyed the structure honouring the slain reporter.

Abu Akleh, a veteran correspondent, was killed in May 2022 during an Israeli military operation in the West Bank city of Jenin.
